description: This file defines the interface for a reftable stack, including functions for creating, managing, iterating, compacting, and cleaning a stack of reftables, as well as handling transactions and retrieving statistics.

methods.name: reftable_new_stack
methods.description: Opens a new reftable stack in the specified directory with given options.

methods.name: reftable_stack_next_update_index
methods.description: Returns the update index for the next table to be written.

methods.name: reftable_stack_new_addition
methods.description: Creates a new transaction to add reftables to the stack, locking the database.

methods.name: reftable_addition_add
methods.description: Adds a reftable to the current transaction.

methods.name: reftable_addition_commit
methods.description: Commits the current transaction, releasing the lock.

methods.name: reftable_addition_destroy
methods.description: Releases all resources and deallocates the transaction.

methods.name: reftable_stack_add
methods.description: Adds a new reftable to the stack using a write callback.

methods.name: reftable_stack_init_ref_iterator
methods.description: Initializes an iterator for refs in the stack.

methods.name: reftable_stack_init_log_iterator
methods.description: Initializes an iterator for logs in the stack.

methods.name: reftable_stack_merged_table
methods.description: Returns the merged table for seeking.

methods.name: reftable_stack_destroy
methods.description: Frees all resources associated with the stack.

methods.name: reftable_stack_reload
methods.description: Reloads the stack if necessary.

methods.name: reftable_stack_compact_all
methods.description: Compacts all reftables into a giant table, expiring reflog entries if configured.

methods.name: reftable_stack_compaction_required
methods.description: Checks if table compaction is required, using heuristics if specified.

methods.name: reftable_stack_auto_compact
methods.description: Heuristically compacts an unbalanced table stack.

methods.name: reftable_stack_clean
methods.description: Deletes stale .ref tables.

methods.name: reftable_stack_read_ref
methods.description: Reads a single ref; returns error, success, or not found.

methods.name: reftable_stack_read_log
methods.description: Reads a single log; returns error, success, or not found.

methods.name: reftable_stack_compaction_stats
methods.description: Returns statistics on past compactions.

methods.name: reftable_stack_hash_id
methods.description: Returns the hash of the stack.
